title: boots-on-ground-weekly-lighthouse-sep-2026
notes:
Purpose: weekly boots-on-ground snapshot for private deployments (VPC + on-prem). This doc doubles as the meeting notes for the 09/07/2026 field sync and the tactical backlog we promised to surface to Eng Leadership. Tone: operational, pragmatic, lots of raw detail + owner-aware action items.

Attendees (09/07/2026 10:00-10:45 PT): Maya Chen (owner), Alejandro Ruiz (network lead), Priya Nair (onprem systems), Samir Patel (field SRE), Ellie Gordon (solutions eng), + Lauren (customer success, demo). Some team members dropped in/out.

Summary / Headline items:
- Ongoing customer: Acadia Health (on-prem) — elevated latency on inference host after prolonged steady-state. Appears correlated with nightly backup window + KMS rotation job at 00:15 local. Workaround established (stagger KMS rotate + pause backups) but need robust fix.
- VPC customer: NorthStar Analytics — intermittent mount failures to NFS exporter when scale-up occurs (burst autoscale). Root cause hypothesis: NFS server exhausting file handle table under sudden ephemeral worker churn. Temporary mitigation applied: increase nfs.file-max on exporter nodes, applied 09/06 23:40, monitoring.
- Install cadence: 2 new warmstart installs this week; install velocity slightly behind target due to image signing policy review by security (see open action).
- Observability gap: lost granular per-request KV-cache eviction metric in telemetry after agent 2.1.4 -> 2.2.0 upgrade. Tracing shows missing span; flagged to runtime team.

Raw Standup notes (bullet-y, to capture context):
- Maya: ran remote debug with Acadia, reproduced tokenization surge when backup I/O starts. Kernel iowait spikes 60-80% for 2–3 min. Found cron job depends on broad find / -type f pipeline causing disk thrash. Asked customer to scope backup to model-data paths only; customer agreed to trial. Action: Priya to draft backup scoping guide and sample cron 09/08.
- Alejandro: applied nfs.file-max bump on northstar-exporter-1/2; observed decreased mount timeouts in first 12h. Still saw 2 transient failures during a 400-node scale event. Working with cloud infra team to add exponential mount retry in agent. Action: Alejandro + Samir to validate retry backoff in staging by 09/15 (PR #877 reference).
- Samir: observed 3 kernel panics across edge installs in last 7 days. Two were power-cycling issues; one looks like out-of-memory + oom-killer triggered because of unexpected large batch job. Need better OOM protection on onprem runtime. Action: Samir to prototype cgroup delta that caps user batch mem to 75% of host; spike test scheduled 09/13.
- Priya: image-signing policy blocked one customer staged install (security requested ECDSA signatures instead of RSA). Working with security to codify allowed sig algs; will push update to install checklist. Action: Priya to update install checklist and add step in preflight script by 09/09.
- Ellie: CS had an awkward handoff to Acadia (rotation window not clearly communicated). Recommend new customer-facing install calendar + explicit KMS rotation ownership. Action: Ellie to draft calendar template + email template by 09/10.

Open Blockers (ranked):
1) Acadia backup + KMS rotation collision — customer blocked from SLA runway. Temporary mitigation in place; requires a config/ops pattern. Owner: Maya. ETA: 09/14 for documented pattern + long-term patch discussion with runtime team.
2) Observability: missing kv-cache eviction spans after agent upgrade — blocks root-cause analysis for multiple customers. Owner: Samir. Depends on runtime tracing flag rollback. ETA: 09/12 investigation update.
3) Install stall due to image signing algo mismatch — security review needed. Owner: Priya + Security (Rae Ellis). ETA: 09/09.
4) NFS mount edge cases on burst scale — intermittent impact to NorthStar. Owner: Alejandro. ETA: 09/15 test and PR for exponential retry.

Decisions made in meeting:
- Do not pause KMS rotation globally; prefer operational pattern to sequence rotation outside backup windows. Customer must opt-in for staggered schedule.
- For now, accept ECDSA signatures for staged installs; formal security policy update required (security will draft policy change).
- Add a mandatory preflight check that validates NFS exporter limits and recommends a sane file-max baseline for small/medium/large clusters.

Action Items (owners + visible next step):
- Priya: write "backup-scoping-guide.md" snippet + cron examples; add to runbook. Due 2026-09-08.
- Alejandro & Samir: build lightweight exponential mount retry into agent (branch + staging test). PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/deploy-scripts/pull/877. Target staging test 09/15.
- Maya: coordinate Acadia follow-up call for 09/10 08:00 PT and finalize customer communication.
- Samir: re-enable tracing flag (temp rollback) for kv-cache spans; post-mortem entry if resolved. Due 09/12.
- Priya: update install preflight script to validate image signature algorithm and fail fast with remediation. Due 09/09.
- Ellie: create customer install calendar + email template and attach to handoff playbook. Due 09/10.

Field Glossary + quick taxonomies (useful shorthand for future notes):
- "Lighthouse": installs where we place an SRE onsite/remote as the primary contact for first 72h. Not every install, used for high-risk customers.
- "Warmstart": small pilot cluster installed with limited capacity; used to validate data flows.
- "Boots-on-ground": boots actually doing the initial day-1 runbook steps + local network validation.
- "Burst churn": quick addition/removal of ephemeral workers during autoscale events.

Telemetry & Data asks (quick):
- Add per-request KV-cache eviction counters and retention of last 100 eviction keys for 72h. (Reason: recurring missing spans).
- Add a dashboard tile for kernel OOM kill events across on-prem installs (owner: Samir).

Notes to self / loose thoughts (informal):
- Consider a tiny helper agent that watches for heavy find|rsync-style backups hitting model-storage paths; automatically tag/process or nudge customer to use snapshot-based backups. Could be quick MVP as python watchdog.
- Could unify the install calendar with CS's onboarding schedule to avoid overlap with customer ops (KMS rotations, backups, maintenance windows).
